{{Top|leg}}
The '''Office of Transportation''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] department which was part of the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor's]] office. It was responsible for overseeing the licensing of small [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger ships]].
